note: Development seasons only, season-blocked cross-validation. The test seasons are not read by this step, which exits when the grid is done.

how_each_value_was_chosen.structure: Trees start from the normal-approximation baseline (init_score). Study: candidate `base` against `v1_no_platt` (log loss 0.44913 against 0.44973) and `scores_no_base_leaf2000` against `scores_leaf2000` (0.44944 against 0.44863).
how_each_value_was_chosen.baseline_sigma_and_tau: Fitted by maximum likelihood on the training rows of every fit (two numbers). Fixing tau instead was worse: 30 seconds without the rules (`base_sharp`, 0.44968), and 60, 120 or 240 seconds with them (`rules_tau*`: 0.44869 to 0.44929, larger end-game gaps, and the 13-second check further from passing).
how_each_value_was_chosen.baseline_kneel_rule: On. Where the leader with the ball can kneel out (kneel_slack >= 0), the baseline is certain. On development seasons those rows were won 3,313 times in 3,314 (study, final_checks and docs/notes/m1_wp.md). Candidate `rules_kneel_leaf2000` against `scores_leaf2000`: log loss equal (0.44863), end-game gap 0.0048 against 0.0051, kneel-out check passed (minimum 1.000 against 0.924).
how_each_value_was_chosen.baseline_possession_value: Off. A fitted value for having the ball (about 1.6 points) did not help once the trees were in place (`rules_both_leaf2000` 0.44880, `rules_poss_leaf2000` 0.44874).
how_each_value_was_chosen.features: is_home dropped, kneel_slack, possessions and possessions_per_minute added. See decisions below.
how_each_value_was_chosen.min_child_samples: 2000. Study leaf sweep (5000, 2000, 1000, 500, 200) and the tuning grid. 2000 had the best overall log loss of the sweep; 1000 is slightly better on the end-game cells and slightly worse overall, with a larger memorization gap.
how_each_value_was_chosen.num_leaves: 15. Tuning grid (15 against 31 at each leaf size).
how_each_value_was_chosen.n_estimators_and_learning_rate: 300 trees at 0.06, kept from version 1 (its tuning picked 300 of 150, 300, 600). Rechecked by the tuning grid at 150 trees and 0.12, and 600 trees and 0.03.
how_each_value_was_chosen.colsample_bytree_subsample_reg_lambda: 0.8, 0.8 (every round) and 10. Not tuned: common settings kept from version 1 so the number of looks at the data stays small. Stated, not chosen by a score.
how_each_value_was_chosen.max_bin: 127. Not tuned; halves the fit time against LightGBM's 255.
how_each_value_was_chosen.monotone_constraints_method: intermediate. Not tuned; LightGBM's middle setting between the fast basic method and the slow advanced one.
how_each_value_was_chosen.monotone_constraints: Set by reasoning, not by a score: more points, a better spread and more timeouts for the team with the ball can never hurt it; more defensive timeouts never help.
how_each_value_was_chosen.SPREAD_DECAY: 4.0, kept from version 1, where it was set by hand with no recorded comparison. It only shapes one of several spread features, and the trees can undo it. Not tuned.
how_each_value_was_chosen.TIME_FLOOR_SECONDS: 30, kept. Study: a 5-second floor made no difference with the baseline in place (`base_floor5` 0.44933 against `base_no_home` 0.44930; `kneel_floor5_leaf2000` 0.44881 against `kneel_leaf2000` 0.44877).
how_each_value_was_chosen.kneel_constants: 40-second play clock, 2 seconds per kneel, 120-second cap: rules and measurements in docs/research/endgame_clock.md, not fitted to outcomes.
how_each_value_was_chosen.KNEEL_SLACK_FLOOR: -600 seconds. Stated: more than ten minutes from a kneel-out is all the same for this feature, and capping it keeps the trees' bins on the end game.
how_each_value_was_chosen.possessions_per_minute_offset: 30 seconds added to the clock, the same as TIME_FLOOR_SECONDS, so the feature stays finite at 0:00. Not tuned.
how_each_value_was_chosen.BASELINE_LOGIT_CAP: 9 (about 1 in 8,000). Stated, keeps log-odds finite; not tuned.
